name: Full Build Staged Audit

notes: Kept /game/index.html as the minimal bootable safe game entry. Do not replace it while debugging the full build.

This isolates the exact failing full-build module without breaking the public /game/ entry page.
No Unity and no Azure. This remains WebEx/WebXR static game-side work.
